_about: ROADMAP 2.67b. The language a composer writes directions in BESIDES Italian, keyed on the composer slug of a work_id (`mahler--symphony-5` -> `mahler`). Italian and Latin are accepted for every work and are not listed. An empty list means Italian (and Latin) only: the composer's own language is not in the terms library (Russian, Czech, Scandinavian, Hungarian) or is Italian. A composer missing from this table is UNKNOWN and every language is accepted, recorded as such. CONVENTION ASSUMED (Sean 2026-10-12: 'Italian plus the composer's language'): the nationality/working language of each composer below was written from general knowledge, cross-checked against the share of non-Italian words each composer prints in the reference encodings (Beethoven 5 / Brahms 1 excluded). WHAT WOULD FALSIFY IT: a composer here printing a real direction word in an unlisted language that the edition's labels do not also name. NOT CONFIRMED by Sean entry by entry.
